'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Chris Schoenthal LS Local Trouble''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Local Trouble / No Match For A Jedi]]
* '''Username:''' imrahil327
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
